title: Orthodox Church of the Holy Spirit, Vilnius
geometryBasis: The mapped cathedral footprint, public-domain 2007 Qualla photograph and original elevation identify the main monastery church.
sectionBasis: A low west porch with painted pediment fronts a tall cream and yellow wall with paired cupola turrets. A longitudinal roof meets the domed crossing and three vaulted eastern apses.
limitations: This asset covers the principal Orthodox church with its twin west turrets, crossing dome and three apses. The separate bell tower and monastery ranges fall outside this model scope.

The exact 2007 photograph sets the entrance, pilasters, cupola and color. Heights and the side and rear roof details are estimated from the outline and published descriptions. The entrance inscription and icon are simplified.
